_comment: The synthetic half of the demo data, kept apart from anything measured.
Everything build_demo_data.py derives from a real bundle (CPU, clients,
channel counts, the roaming client) stays real and only has its identifiers
replaced. These entries are invented, because a bench with one DUT attached
cannot produce a fleet and the reference capture contained no crash lines.
MACs use the 02: locally-administered prefix so they are visibly not real.

crash.text: wlan1: STA 02:9f:41:c7:0b:e2 deauthenticated (reason 4, inactivity) on both radios
ath_dfs: radar detected on channel 60, moving to channel 149
